description:
Read your own on-chain Pledge record for a launch (free).

Returns how much this wallet has pledged, its share of the raise, its
remaining headroom under the per-wallet cap, the projected pro-rata
allocation, how much the liquidity release schedule has unlocked vs already
released, and whether an on-chain refund is available (refunds open only if
the raise FAILS its minimum).

Workflow: MONITOR step -- poll this between the cliff and full release to
decide when a claim_ilo_tokens call is worth making.
name: get_my_pledge_status
